item.title: Matt Damon and Noah Kahan on ‘SNL’: How to Watch the Sketch Comedy TV Series Live Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's trending news on Billboard. I've got the scoop on Saturday Night Live's upcoming episode and how you can catch it online for free.
This Saturday, May 9th, Matt Damon returns to host SNL for his third time, with folk singer-songwriter Noah Kahan as the musical guest. You can catch the show live on NBC at 11:30 PM ET or 8:30 PM PT, or livestream it on Peacock Premium.
But if you don't have cable, don't worry. There are a few ways to watch SNL online for free. You can grab a free trial with DirecTV, which offers a five-day trial to stream NBC live online. Alternatively, you can check out Sling Blue, Peacock Premium, or Hulu + Live TV, which all offer access to NBC and live TV channels.
[Short musical break]
Host: "Matt Damon is promoting his new film, The Odyssey, directed by Christopher Nolan, while Noah Kahan is fresh off the release of his latest album, The Great Divide. And if you're a fan of Kahan, you can catch him on tour starting June 11th.
That's all for now. If you want to catch SNL online, be sure to check out those streaming options. And for more entertainment news and product recommendations, stay tuned to Billboard.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for listening, and we'll catch you next time."
